English: Looks like those night classes I took in flying fixed wing aircraft are about to pay off.

Head North East of Everon over the sea. Destination: Kolgujev.

Now that the air defenses have been neutralized to the South of Kolgujev, you're being assigned to an A-10 ground attack squadron. Your objective is to take out as many enemy tanks as you can in the Southern half of the island. Be careful: we haven't been able to deal with the AA guns to the North yet.

You'll take off from the airport.
